title: Really fun way to see the city.
text: Fun game, gorgeous views. Lovely way to see the city. Especially liked solving all the riddles and exploring the Alhambra.
author: cjW5761YK

title: Great day out...
text: Such a beautiful walk and a great game! Particularly enjoyed the Albaicin and views of the Alhambra. Really enjoyed it.
